title: Great little shelf!
text: Great little shelf!. Fits great in a tight space... not sure how much weight it can actually hold, but it's great for towels and bath accessories!!

product_metadata.title: Seville Classics Iron Slat Tower Shelving, 3-Tier (Pewter)
features: SOLID IRON SLATS - Satin pewter epoxy finish provides necessary corrosion resistance in dry environments for durable multipurpose storage in a modern style.
COMPACT FOOTPRINT - Tower footprint measures just over 1 sq. ft. , perfect for small spaces in the bathroom and around the home.
EXPANDABLE STORAGE - Interlock with compatible Seville Classics 4-Tier Iron Slat Tower Shelving (SKU: SHE04125B) to build a storage system that suits your needs.
STURDY SHELVES - Each shelf holds up to 90 lbs. evenly distributed for 90 lbs. of storage per tower. It's perfect for pantry and kitchen storage of cans, bags, and foodstuffs.
EASY ASSEMBLY - No tools required. Simply snap the shelves into the frames and adjust the leveling feet as needed for your floor.
description: Choose the stylish home storage solution with Seville Classics' 3-Tier Iron Slat Tower Shelving. Store up to 30 lbs per shelf in the versatile and modern shelf perfect around the home. Unit features four iron slat shelves that snap easily into the folding iron frame. No tools are required for easy assembly and portability. Unit interlocks with compatible Seville Classics 4-Tier Iron Slat Tower Shelving (SKU: SHE04117B) to build a storage system that suits your needs. Iron frame with a satin-pewter epoxy finish Interlock shelving allows you to bridge multiple units Strong iron slats can hold up to 90 lbs. evenly distributed per shelf Easy assembly, no tools required Frame folds flat for minimal storage Specifications Dimensions: 11. 25" D x 25. 4" W x 32. 25" H Weight capacity: 30 lbs. per shelf, 90 lbs. overall evenly distributed Weight: 16 lbs. Model #: SHE04117B
